name: @globalens/infra
description: Turborepo entry for the OpenTofu stacks and their Conftest policies. These scripts need no credentials and no network: `mise run tofu:validate` and `mise run tofu:plan` do the rest.

scripts.lint: tofu fmt -check -recursive . && conftest fmt --check policy && uv run --no-sync ruff check . && uv run --no-sync ruff format --check .
